_: Small pre-drawn word images, keyed by build_pack.py's image key (format, size, pixels, palette). "text": redrawn with the pack's text font in the original colour and place ("dot": which side the town dot is on; it is redrawn as a ring); "upscale": an image that build_pack.py would otherwise skip as a tiny label, upscaled like any other. "numbers": [x0, y0, x1, y1] region of a picture whose painted numbers (the journal calendar) are removed before the upscale and redrawn with the text font after it. "buttons": [[x0, y0, w, h, n64 button]] controller-button icons painted into a picture (the inventory page's "Details" C-down), erased before the upscale and redrawn as the Xbox button after it (buttons.py). "marks": [[x0, y0, w, h, text]] small text painted into a picture over nothing (the title card's TM), made transparent before the upscale and redrawn with the text font after it, in its colour, capitals one texel short of the box.
